summary: Frontend-only e2e for The Coach feature (build templates + accountability plan-checks). All 5 requested scenarios PASS with 0 console errors. Real Claude calls made 3× (Content Director Ask-the-Coach, Executioner coach-how-btn-A, plan-check upload) plus 1 no-plan upload — total 4 AI billings this run.
test_scenarios_verified: Content Director → data-testid=ask-the-coach card renders at the bottom (above VideoVault). Typing 'How do gift card pushes work?' into coach-topic-input and clicking coach-ask-btn showed 'Coaching…' loading state, then coach-template-panel appeared with a real brand-voiced title ('Gift Card Push: How It Works for Nonna\'s Corner Deli'), why-it-works blurb, Key Elements (6 bullets), 'Your Offer — fill in the blanks' template, Shot List with tips, Where It Goes, and a Success Check footer. Toast 'Your build template is ready' fired. Real Claude call ~30s.

coach-template-pdf Download PDF link: href = https://template-vault-41.preview.emergentagent.com/api/coach/template/{id}/pdf. Requested via page.request with owner cookie → HTTP 200, content-type application/pdf, 3100 bytes body starting with %PDF magic. Same PDF check re-run on the Executioner-generated template → 200 application/pdf.

Executioner → recommended-plan card renders two strategies (Paid Local Velocity + Organic Community Outreach); each has coach-how-btn-A and coach-how-btn-B. Clicking coach-how-btn-A showed toast 'Build template ready · Scroll down…' and rendered coach-template-panel BELOW the plan card (real AI ~40s) with strategy-specific title 'Paid Local Velocity: Facebook Act-Now Ads + Google Maps Pin Boost' + brand-voiced content mentioning Nonna\'s Corner Deli, Springfield. Both A and B buttons present and clickable.

Content Director Video Critic → plan-check-row renders ABOVE critic-upload-zone (row y=523, zone y=572). Focusing plan-check-select triggers getCoachTemplates() lazily and populates 4 options: 'No plan — just grade it' (default, value=''), Paid Local Velocity, Gift Card Push, and How Sub Specials Work at Nonna\'s Corner Deli (>=2 saved templates as required). Selecting the 'Sub Specials' template + uploading /tmp/t.mp4 (29843 bytes, testsrc 2s) triggered upload → analyzing → after ~90s: critic-report rendered with Overall grade WEAK PLUS plan-check-result block containing plan-check-verdict chip 'OFF-PLAN' + matched line + 3 concrete re-film/edit fix bullets (each prefixed with →).

Uploading same clip with NO template selected ('No plan — just grade it') → default select value confirmed '' → analyze completed → critic-report rendered → plan-check-result block correctly ABSENT (page.query_selector returned None).
Regression Content Director: transcript-input textarea and generate-copy-btn (Speech→Copy) render correctly. video-vault card renders at page bottom.
Regression Maximizer: nav-maximizer opens Quality Customer Maximizer page ('Turn the click into a customer — and prove the order …'); 0 error-class elements, 0 console errors.
critical_code_review_comments: Coach.js is clean (105 lines) — well-scoped, TemplatePanel and AskTheCoach share nicely.

ContentDirector.js is now 363 lines with imports — still comfortably under the 700-line split threshold, but it now owns 3 async flows (copywriter, critic upload/analyze, coach template list). If a 4th async flow lands, consider extracting the Video Critic block into its own file. Non-blocking.

getCoachTemplates() is triggered on select onFocus — works, but on Firefox / touch devices onFocus doesn\'t always fire before the option click. Consider also fetching once on mount (useEffect) so the list is ready before the user even opens the dropdown. Minor UX polish, not blocking.

plan-check-result background colors are hardcoded hex (#EAFAF1 / #FEF5E7 / #FDEDEC) rather than theme tokens — fine for accessibility (checked contrast is OK) but inconsistent with the rest of the app that uses var(--surface-alt) etc. Cosmetic.
No console.error / no failed network requests observed across 4 AI-heavy scenarios — very clean.

success_rate.backend: not tested this iteration (main agent reports 85/85 pytest green)

test_credentials: Owner cookie session_token=tok_owner_e2e used successfully on scan-spin-staging.preview.emergentagent.com.
seed_data_creation: 3 coach templates now exist in the DB via this test run: (a) 'Gift Card Push: How It Works for Nonna\'s Corner Deli' (id 418ea782..., from Content Director Ask-the-Coach), (b) 'Paid Local Velocity: Facebook Act-Now Ads + Google Maps Pin Boost' (id 7c9d349d..., from Executioner coach-how-btn-A), plus the pre-existing 'How Sub Specials Work at Nonna\'s Corner Deli' (id a578beb1...). If the next iteration wants a clean slate they can be deleted via the backend, but the plan-check-select requires >=2 templates so leaving them helps future runs. Two /tmp/t.mp4 uploads (~29 KB each) were analyzed and stored under the critic uploads.
context_for_next_testing_agent: 1) Real Claude calls cost budget — the coach template flow takes ~30-40s per call; the plan-check upload+analyze takes ~90s-3min because it runs Whisper + Vision + a second LLM call for the plan check. 2) A tiny testsrc mp4 (2s, 320x240, 29KB) generated via imageio_ffmpeg is enough for the full pipeline — see review_request.agent_to_agent_context_note for the exact ffmpeg command. 3) plan-check-select is populated ONLY onFocus (lazy). If a Playwright test uses select_option before focusing, the options aren\'t there — call select.focus() + wait ~2.5s first. 4) The 'No plan' option has value='' which triggers criticAnalyze(uploadId, filename, null) → backend skips the plan check → plan-check-result block does not render (guarded by `report && planCheck`). 5) Executioner coach-how-btn-A/B is inside plan-strategy-A / plan-strategy-B and is disabled while coachBusy is truthy — the busy label 'Coaching…' does show up. 6) coach-template-pdf href is absolute (uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL) so an anchor download works cross-origin with credentials; page.request.get(href) works too since the cookie is set at browser context level.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found. Feature works end-to-end: real AI template generation, PDF download with correct content-type, plan-check verdict + fixes on a synthetic clip, and clean regression on Copywriter / VideoVault / Maximizer.
